analyze_image.title: Analyse an image
analyze_image.description: Run Image Analysis 4.0 over an image URL and get back whichever visual features you ask for: a natural-language caption, dense region captions, tags, detected objects with bounding boxes, people, smart crop suggestions, and printed or handwritten text via read. Ask for only the features you need -- each one costs a transaction. caption and denseCaptions are available in a subset of regions only.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image, at least 50x50 and under 20 MB.

features.description: Comma-separated visual features to compute: caption, denseCaptions, tags, objects, people, smartCrops, read.

language.description: BCP-47 language for the returned captions and tags. Defaults to en.

gender_neutral_caption.description: Return "person" rather than "man" or "woman" in captions.

smart_crop_aspect_ratios.description: Comma-separated aspect ratios for smartCrops, between 0.75 and 1.8, e.g. "0.9,1.33".

model_version.description: Pin a model version instead of the current default.

api_version.description: Image Analysis API version to call.

output.description: One block per requested feature, plus the image's dimensions.

objectsResult.description: Each detected object with its boundingBox.

readResult.description: Lines and words of text found in the image.

extract_text_from_image.title: Read text in an image (OCR)
extract_text_from_image.description: Extract printed and handwritten text from an image URL, returning each line and word with its bounding polygon and confidence. This is the read feature of Image Analysis 4.0 on its own -- reach for analyze_document instead when the input is a multi-page PDF or a form whose structure matters.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image to read text from.

model_version.description: Pin a model version instead of the current default.

api_version.description: Image Analysis API version to call.

output.description: The text found, as blocks of lines and words with their positions.

readResult.description: blocks, each with lines carrying text, boundingPolygon and words.

analyze_text_for_harm.title: Screen text for harmful content
analyze_text_for_harm.description: Score a piece of text against the Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual and Violence categories, returning a severity per category. Use FourSeverityLevels (0, 2, 4, 6) for the usual moderation gate, or EightSeverityLevels for finer control. Pass blocklist_names to also match your own banned terms, and halt_on_blocklist_hit to skip the AI categories once one matches.

text.description: The text to screen. Up to 10K characters per call.
text.example: I will find you and hurt you.

categories.description: Which harm categories to score. Omit for all four.

blocklist_names.description: Names of custom blocklists to match the text against as well.

halt_on_blocklist_hit.description: Stop and return as soon as a blocklist term matches, skipping the AI categories.

output_type.description: Severity scale -- four levels (0/2/4/6) or eight (0-7).

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: A severity per harm category, plus any blocklist terms matched.

blocklistsMatch.description: Each with blocklistName, blocklistItemId and blocklistItemText.

analyze_image_for_harm.title: Screen an image for harmful content
analyze_image_for_harm.description: Score an image against the Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual and Violence categories. Give a blob URL, or base64 image bytes in image_content. The image must be under 4 MB and between 50x50 and 7200x7200 pixels.

blob_url.description: URL of the image in blob storage. Give this or image_content.

image_content.description: The image bytes, base64-encoded. Give this or blob_url.

categories.description: Which harm categories to score. Omit for all four.

output_type.description: Severity scale for image analysis -- four levels is the supported default.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: A severity per harm category for the image.

list_blocklists.title: List content safety blocklists
list_blocklists.description: List the custom text blocklists on this resource. A blocklist is a set of terms analyze_text_for_harm can match against by name, alongside the AI harm categories.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: Every blocklist on the resource.

get_blocklist.title: Get a content safety blocklist
get_blocklist.description: Read one blocklist's name and description. Use list_blocklist_items to see the terms it actually holds.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: The blocklist's metadata.

create_or_update_blocklist.title: Create or update a content safety blocklist
create_or_update_blocklist.description: Create a blocklist, or change the description of one that exists. The terms themselves go in through add_or_update_blocklist_items; this call only manages the list itself.

blocklist_name.description: Name of the blocklist to create or update.

description.description: What this blocklist is for, shown when listing.
description.example: Competitor names we do not publish

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: The blocklist as stored after the write.

delete_blocklist.title: Delete a content safety blocklist
delete_blocklist.description: Remove a blocklist and every term in it. Any analyze_text_for_harm call still naming the list will start failing, so drop the reference first.

blocklist_name.description: Name of the blocklist to delete.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_blocklist_items.title: List the terms in a blocklist
list_blocklist_items.description: Page through the terms a blocklist holds, each with the id you need to remove it. Use top and skip to walk a large list.

top.description: How many terms to return per page.

skip.description: How many terms to skip, for paging.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: A page of blocklist terms.

value.description: Each with blocklistItemId, description and text.

add_or_update_blocklist_items.title: Add terms to a blocklist
add_or_update_blocklist_items.description: Add or replace terms in a blocklist. Each item is an object with text and an optional description; a term whose text already exists is updated rather than duplicated. Up to 100 items per call. Changes can take a few minutes to take effect on analysis calls.

blocklist_name.description: Name of the blocklist to add to.

items.description: The terms to add, each an object with text and an optional description.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: The terms as stored, each with the id assigned to it.

blocklistItems.description: Each with blocklistItemId, text and description.

remove_blocklist_items.title: Remove terms from a blocklist
remove_blocklist_items.description: Delete terms from a blocklist by their blocklistItemId, which list_blocklist_items reports. Up to 100 ids per call; removal can take a few minutes to take effect on analysis calls.

blocklist_name.description: Name of the blocklist to remove from.

item_ids.description: Ids of the terms to remove, from list_blocklist_items.

api_version.description: Content Safety API version to call.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

analyze_document.title: Analyse a document
analyze_document.description: Run a Document Intelligence model over a document URL. model_id picks what you get: prebuilt-read for text, prebuilt-layout for tables and structure, prebuilt-invoice, prebuilt-receipt, prebuilt-idDocument and prebuilt-tax.us.w2 for typed fields, or a custom model id you trained. Asynchronous -- the response is 202 with an operation-location header whose last path segment is the result id for get_document_analysis_result.

model_id.description: Model to run -- prebuilt-read, prebuilt-layout, prebuilt-invoice, prebuilt-receipt, prebuilt-idDocument, or a custom model id.

document_url.description: Publicly reachable or SAS-signed URL of the PDF, image or Office file.

pages.description: Page range to analyse, e.g. "1-2,5". Omit for every page.

locale.description: Locale hint that improves extraction accuracy, e.g. en-GB.

features.description: Comma-separated add-on capabilities, e.g. ocrHighResolution, languages, barcodes, formulas, keyValuePairs, queryFields.

output_content_format.description: Return the document content as plain text or as Markdown.

string_index_type.description: How character offsets in the result are counted.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: Empty body; the operation-location response header ends in the result id to pass to get_document_analysis_result.

get_document_analysis_result.title: Get a document analysis result
get_document_analysis_result.description: Fetch the outcome of an analyze_document call. status moves through notStarted and running to succeeded or failed; once succeeded, analyzeResult holds the content, pages, tables, paragraphs, key-value pairs and typed documents the model produced.

model_id.description: The same model id the analyze call used.

result_id.description: Result id from the analyze call's operation-location header.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: The analysis status and, once succeeded, the extracted content.

analyzeResult.description: content, pages, tables, paragraphs, keyValuePairs, documents.

list_document_models.title: List document models
list_document_models.description: List the Document Intelligence models available on this resource -- every prebuilt model plus any custom models trained here -- with the api-version each was built against.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: A page of document models.

value.description: Each with modelId, description, createdDateTime and apiVersion.

get_document_model.title: Get a document model
get_document_model.description: Read one model's details, including the document types it recognises and the field schema each produces. Use it to discover what a custom model will return before running it.

model_id.description: Id of the model to describe.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: The model's metadata and field schema.

docTypes.description: Per document type, the fieldSchema and confidence.

delete_document_model.title: Delete a custom document model
delete_document_model.description: Remove a custom Document Intelligence model. Prebuilt models cannot be deleted. Any pipeline still naming the model id starts failing at once, and the model cannot be recovered without retraining.

model_id.description: Id of the custom model to delete.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

get_document_intelligence_info.title: Get Document Intelligence quota
get_document_intelligence_info.description: Report the resource's custom model quota -- how many custom models it holds and how many it may hold. Check this before training, since the limit is per resource and training fails once it is reached.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: Custom model count and limit for the resource.

list_document_operations.title: List Document Intelligence operations
list_document_operations.description: List the long-running operations on this resource -- model builds, copies and composes -- with the status and percentage complete of each. Results are kept for 24 hours.

api_version.description: Document Intelligence API version to call.

output.description: A page of recent operations and their status.

value.description: Each with operationId, kind, status, percentCompleted and resourceLocation.

analyze_text.title: Run a Language text analysis task
analyze_text.description: Call the Language feature on this multi-service resource: sentiment, key phrases, entities, PII, entity linking or language detection over a batch of documents. kind picks the task and parameters carries its options. The dedicated azure-ai-language connector exposes this surface in full, including the asynchronous jobs and authoring APIs.

kind.description: The analysis task -- SentimentAnalysis, EntityRecognition, KeyPhraseExtraction, LanguageDetection, PiiEntityRecognition or EntityLinking.

documents.description: The documents, each an object with id, language and text. Ids must be unique.

parameters.description: Task options, whose keys depend on kind.

api_version.description: Language REST API version to call.

output.description: The task's results, shaped by the kind requested.

translate_text.title: Translate text
translate_text.description: Translate one or more strings into one or more target languages, using this resource's own Translator endpoint. from is optional -- omit it and the service detects the source language and reports it alongside the translation. The dedicated azure-ai-translator connector covers transliteration, dictionary lookup and sentence breaking as well.

texts.description: The strings to translate. Up to 100 per call, 50,000 characters in total.

to.description: Target language code, e.g. fr, de, zh-Hans. One per call -- the API expresses several targets by repeating the query parameter, which a single value cannot represent.

from_language.description: Source language code. Omit to let the service detect it.

text_type.description: Whether the input is plain text or contains HTML markup to preserve.

profanity_action.description: Leave profanity as translated, remove it, or replace it with asterisks.

output.description: One entry per input string, each carrying its translations.

items.description: detectedLanguage (when from was omitted) and translations, each with text and to.

list_translator_languages.title: List supported translation languages
list_translator_languages.description: List the languages this resource's Translator supports, for translation, transliteration and dictionary lookup, with each language's name in English and in its own script. Use it to validate a language code before calling translate_text.

scope.description: Comma-separated groups to return: translation, transliteration, dictionary.

output.description: The supported languages, grouped by the scopes requested.
